creation\n- Prevents malicious JavaScript aggregators from being instantiated\n\n### 3. javascript-postaggregator-security.patch\n**File**: `processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/aggregation/post/JavaScriptPostAggregator.java`\n- Adds security check to the constructor to validate JavaScript is enabled before allowing post-aggregator creation\n- Prevents malicious JavaScript post-aggregators from being instantiated\n\n### 4. javascript-extraction-security.patch\n**File**: `processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/extraction/JavaScriptExtractionFn.java`\n- Adds security check to the constructor to validate JavaScript is enabled before allowing extraction function Prevents malicious JavaScript parse specs from being instantiated\n\n## Already Protected Components\n\nThe following components already had proper security checks in their constructors and were not vulnerable:\n- `JavaScriptWorkerSelectStrategy` (indexing-service)\n- `JavaScriptTieredBrokerSelectorStrategy` (server)\n\n## Fix Mechanism\n\nAll patches add the following security check to the constructor:\n\n```java\n// Security check: Ensure JavaScript is enabled before allowing JavaScript <component> creation\n// This prevents bypassing security checks via deserialization with crafted
